test_check_correctness: test the check_correctness function to evaluate functional correctness of a code completion with a timeout
run_unsafe_execute: run unsafe_execute to safely execute a check program in a sandboxed environment with I/O redirection
build_reliability_guard: build a reliability_guard call to disable destructive OS functions and modules before running untrusted code
